Game Overview

In Jushimo, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Jushimo, a captivating platformer set in a vivid fantasy world. Outsmart enemies and dodge cunning traps as you collect coins. With each level's increasing intensity and strategic surprises, your reflexes and cunning will be pushed to their limits amidst retro charm and thrilling plot twists.
